title: Aeronautics: Lightweight
description: Lightweight, take off! – Pure flight on NeoForge 1.21.1.
body:
# Aeronautics: Lightweight

*No bloat. Just flight.*

Built on **NeoForge 1.21.1**, this pack strips away everything unnecessary and delivers the core experience of **Create: Aeronautics** — with real physics, modular airships, and ground vehicles.

Paired with **Sodium** and **Iris**, you get silky-smooth frames and stunning shader support. **Distant Horizons** extends your view to the horizon, making every high-altitude flight breathtaking.

All of this, lightweight and optimized. No filler. No lag. Just you, your machines, and the open sky.

**Multi-language support (Chinese, English, Russian, and more).**

> **Fly further. See further. Build further.**
